== Summary ==
Players Committee's full-card image of [[Anakin's Lightsaber (V) (Virtual Set 0)|Anakin's Lightsaber (V)]] for [[Virtual Set 0]]. The image matches the game text on page 13 of the 2016 master.<ref>[https://web.archive.org/web/20160806222234/http://www.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-0.pdf Players Committee Set 0 master], page 13.</ref> The publisher repository retains the full card.<ref>[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/swccgpc/holotable/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual0-Light/large/anakinslightsaber.gif Players Committee Holotable repository], exact 8 July 2018 source image.</ref>
